subject: reasoning
question:
In the figure given below the rectangle represents pants, the triangle represents shirts and the circle represents shoes. The number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd8df9b58c40eec9d47c7257cc781461ec82fa5d1d6b814bee0469aeaeadbfbd.png] 

How many shoes are pants?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fec1ab72265adec1946f859df361266b1a7520a7a690dfbd069831fefbb5fef.png] 

The shaded area represents the number of shoes which are pants → 9 + 8 = 17 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
